name: Pyrite
description: Fool's gold that behaves like the real thing. Pyrite is traditionally worn for wealth, drive and getting things done.
mineral: Pyrite is iron sulfide, nicknamed fool's gold for its brassy metallic shine. In the rock it often grows as near-perfect cubes.
wornFor: A pyrite bracelet is traditionally worn for wealth, willpower and the drive to act on a plan. Pyrite belongs to the solar plexus chakra and is linked with Leo. It is a favourite with people who run their own business, and it is paired with citrine in The Alchemist for a gold-toned abundance piece. Keep it dry, because moisture slowly dulls and tarnishes pyrite.
wristWhy: Wear pyrite on the left wrist when you wear it for abundance, the receiving side. If you wear it for drive and action, some people prefer the right.
waterNote: Pyrite is iron sulfide and tarnishes when wet, so keep it dry.
